items.title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response

reading: This is a study version, not a copy of the BBC article. Use it as a longer training text before you open the original link. The news item is a current event. Your first job is to find the actor, the action, and the result.

For language practice, focus on these words: palestinians, settlements, announces, sanctions. Say them aloud, then use each one in your own sentence. Finally, write a three-sentence mini report: one sentence for the event, one for the context, and one for the possible consequence.
